clips.title: Progress
paras: Need another suit, do ya? Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here ya go friend - put this thing on, and you'll have ten minutes to do whatever. Good luck!
Oh, and if you happen to find a key to get me out of here, BY ALL MEANS LET ME KNOW!!!
